data.text:
Surendra Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 August,
2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad 
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:126802
Court No. - 5
Case :- Writ - A No. - 11156 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Surendra Kumar
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashok Kumar Pandey 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble J.J. Munir,J.
The petitioner is a Senior Assistant in the establishment of the Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety
and Drugs Administration, Lalitpur.  He has been transferred vide the impugned transfer order dated 30.06.2024 issued by the Additional Commissioner (Administration) in the Office of the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, Lucknow from Lalitpur to Etawah in public interest. 
Mr. A. K. Pandey, learned Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the transfer order is in violation of the State's Transfer Policy dated 11.06.2024, inasmuch as, the petitioner's wife is posted as an Assistant Teacher at Lalitpur and the policy is clear that the husband and wife, as far as possible, should be posted at the same station. The other ground is that the petitioner's wife has suffered an accident, on account of which she is bed ridden and requires medical care and attention. 
The violation of the State's Transfer Policy howsoever gross is not a ground for this Court to issue a Surendra Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149451163/
1 writ. Nevertheless, violation of the State's Transfer Policy is alleged by the petitioner, which they ought to adhere to. The petitioner has already represented in the matter to the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, U. P., Lucknow vide his representation dated 03.07.2024, which has been duly recommended by the Assistant Commissioner (Food)-II, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, Ballia. 
In the circumstances, the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, U. P., Lucknow is ordered to decide the petitioner's representation dated 03.07.2024 within a week of receipt of a copy of this order in accordance with the State's Transfer Policy and communicate the result to the petitioner within three days of recording his decision. 
This petition is disposed of in terms of the aforesaid orders. 
Let this order be communicated to the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, U. P.,
Lucknow through the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Lucknow by the Registrar (Compliance) within 48 hours. 
Order Date :- 6.8.2024 Vijay  Surendra Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149451163/
2
